scenario_name: Demo: office and gaming demand in one run

users.prompt: I use a MacBook Air and want a proper 27-ish inch desk monitor. One USB-C cable would be ideal and I'd rather stay below €300.
Need something for coding, minimum 1440p. I don't care about brand. Around €250 would be perfect.
My laptop only has USB-C ports, so I need a monitor that charges over USB-C. 27 inch, QHD, max €320.
Home office upgrade: at least 27 inch, 1440p, height adjustable stand would be nice. I can pay up to €300.
Anything 27 inch or bigger with a sharp picture for spreadsheets and documents. Around €280.
I want a gaming monitor, 27 inch, 1440p, 165hz or better, FreeSync, max €450.
Looking for a fast 27 inch 1440p gaming screen, at least 165Hz with adaptive sync. Budget €430.
Competitive shooters mostly. 27 inch, QHD, 180Hz or more, FreeSync. I can spend €420.
